(i) RF spoiling with a phase increment between 118.2 and 121.8 is not sufficient to ensure accurate T1 quantitation, and that (ii) a phase increment of at least 50° is necessary to ensure accurate T _{1} quantitation.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of RF spoiling for T1 quantitation is problematic and that the use of a spoiling phase of 50° should be avoided.
